scope: Offline target decomposition and fresh in-memory raw-400D critic fits on the saved 300-state context trace only.

target_definitions.T1_FORMAL_GAE: Stored formal duration-aware SMDP GAE return target, recomputed from trace and asserted equivalent.
target_definitions.T3_REWARD_ONLY_LAMBDA_RETURN: Duration-aware lambda recursion over rewards with all critic bootstrap values zero; diagnostic only.
target_definitions.T4_ONE_STEP_BOOTSTRAP_TARGET: R + gamma^L * V_old(next) for nonterminal transitions and R for terminal transitions; diagnostic only.

gae_recomputation.terminal_behavior: Terminal transitions set next-value bootstrap to zero and cut the future trace; A_terminal=delta_terminal and no advantage propagates across an episode boundary.

formal_gae_decomposition.reconstruction_formula: target_value_baseline_component + reward_component + bootstrap_next_component + current_value_component + gae_recursive_component = T1; current_value_component is the signed -V_old(current) term inside TD_DELTA.

offline_critic_fit.purpose: Fresh temporary in-memory diagnostic critics on raw 400D observations only; no checkpoint initialization or write.
offline_critic_fit.architecture: v9-style 400->128->128->1, SiLU hidden activations, input transform 2*x-1

ranking_present_but_scale_misaligned.rule: Per target/fold at step 200, correlation > 0.4 and TEST_EV < 0.

bootstrap_root_cause_gate.propagation_rule: YES requires |global Pearson| and |global Spearman| >=0.5 plus same-sign Pearson/Spearman >=4/5 episode correlations; PARTIAL denotes moderate global or strong-but-not-episode-stable association.
bootstrap_root_cause_gate.instability_rule: Three gates: T1 scale CV and max/min ratio each >=1.25x T2; T1 step-200 unseen EV is >=0.1 below T2 in >=3/4 folds; bootstrap-gap discrepancy propagation YES. Two of three = PARTIAL.
bootstrap_root_cause_gate.critic_bootstrap_primary_rule: YES requires T3 to match T2 in cross-episode scale (CV and max/min within 1.2x) and median EV, while both bootstrap-bearing T1/T4 have >=1.25x worse scale CV/max-min and >=0.1 worse median EV than T2. T2-like T3 scale plus worse T1/T4 but poor T3 held-out fit is UNCLEAR; otherwise report PARTIAL/UNCLEAR based on the direction of evidence.

final_requested_fields.NEXT_DECISION: Keep v9 and formal GAE unchanged. Continue with episode/origin-stratified value calibration diagnostics: T1 scale instability is large, but bootstrap-gap versus GAE-return discrepancy correlation is near zero and T3 unseen EV is worse than T2, so bootstrap is not established as the sole primary cause.
